1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 d6 4.d4 Nf6 5.Bd.strategy: Guards e4 against the knight on f6 and leaves the c1-bishop free to take the f4 pawn. White is about to regain the gambit pawn and keep a full centre, so the game becomes a fight for the centre in which White has the more comfortable side.
1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 d6 4.d4 Nf6 5.Bd.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Fischer Defence, Spanish Variation
